title: SIDESTORY: ENDING A GRAND OVERTURE OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: ENDING A GRAND OVERTURE OPEN
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 29, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Ending a Grand Overture event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
Phase 1 [Die a Hero Or a Villain]
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 22, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Phase 2 [Once upon a Time]
[Pending Bills]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Pending Bills] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Catherine], Londinium Railway Platform (Pieces), Module Materials, 'Nay!', etc.
[Office of Proposed Resolutions]
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 29, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain 'Nay!' by clearing event stages and completing [Pending Bills] missions. 'Nay!' can be used to redeem items from [Office of Proposed Resolutions].
REWARDS: Catherine's token, Londinium Railway Platform (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Whistlewind Series - Queen, No. 1 for Bagpipe, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
-During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
-After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Intermezzi].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – NEVER GILDED
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 22, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Never Gilded], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Vina Victoria
★★★★★: Bobbing / Lucilla

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Vina Victoria
★★★★★: Bobbing / Catherine
Note:
- Operator Catherine is currently ONLY available from the Ending a Grand Overture event, and is NOT available in [Never Gilded] headhunting or any [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting].
- Vina Victoria and Bobbing will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after April 22, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Vina Victoria, Bobbing, and Catherine will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 SUPPORT RECRUITMENT UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: April 8, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: After the update on April 8, 10:00 (UTC-7), players will be able to swap the skills and modules of Support Units.
05 SANITY LIMIT INCREASED
UPDATE TIME: April 8, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the update on April 8, 10:00 (UTC-7), all players will receive an increase of 45 to their maximum Sanity, and be granted 45 additional Sanity post-update. The new Sanity cap will be 180. The amount of Sanity recovered per 1 piece of Originite Prime will be updated to 135 for all players.
06 BASE SYSTEM UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: April 08, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the version update on April 08, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7), Quick Shifts will be added to the Base system. Formations can be preset in Work Zones (Factory, Trading Post, and Power Plant). A 'Craftable' tip will appear when certain materials can be processed in the Workshop, while players can tap on the tip to process them.
07 WITCH FEAST SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 22, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Witch Feast Series - The Shadow of the Dark Moon for Degenbrecher
Witch Feast Series - Explosive Blue Flame for Blaze
Witch Feast Series - Starry Night Sky for Bassline
Witch Feast Series - Witch's Swing for Popukar
08 WITCH FEAST SERIES RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 22, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Witch Feast Series - Trust Your Eyes for Lee
Witch Feast Series - Like Illusion for Kazemaru
Witch Feast Series - Mirror Visitor for Iris
Witch Feast Series - Divine Oath for Fiammetta
Witch Feast Series - Hand of Destiny for Dorothy
Witch Feast Series - The Bard's Tale for Quercus
Witch Feast Series - Priory of Abyss for Whisperain
09 NEW FURNITURE SET – LONDINIUM RAILWAY PLATFORM
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, Londinium Railway Platform will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Ending a Grand Overture event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 22, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
10 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
[GUARD CHIP PACK]
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 22, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip * 4, Guard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
[NEVER GILDED HEADHUNTING PACK]
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 21, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Never Gilded Headhunting Permit * 2
[NEVER GILDED HEADHUNTING BUNDLE]
DURATION: April 8, 2025, 10:00 – April 21, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Exclusive Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1
Note:
- Never Gilded Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform one roll in [Never Gilded]. Exclusive Ten-roll Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Never Gilded].
- Never Gilded Headhunting Permit & Exclusive Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expire on: April 22, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7).
Recalibrate Kernel Headhunting Pack (Limited to 2 purchases)
UPDATE TIME: April 08, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Availability: Within 14 days from the date when the Comeback Mission becomes available in the game, starting April 08, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7).
CONTENT: Ten-roll Kernel Headhunting Permit * 1
11 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - The Other Side of Siracusa for Vigil
